 Devils at Jets projected lineups
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 November 10, 2026 
 Link copied 
 DEVILS (13-5-0) at JETS (7-8-3) 
 7 p.m. ET; TSN3, MSGSN 
 Devils projected lineup 
 Arseny Gritsyuk -- Jack Hughes -- Jesper Bratt
 Timo Meier -- Nico Hischier -- Luke Evangelista
 Evan Rodrigues -- Cody Glass -- Connor Brown
 Amadeus Lombardi -- Jesper Boqvist
 Luke Hughes -- Brett Pesce
 Jonas Siegenthaler -- Dougie Hamilton
 Declan Chisholm -- Johnathan Kovacevic
 Brenden Dillon
 Jake Allen
 Connor Hellebuyck
 Scratched: Riley Tufte 
 Injured: Anthony Mantha (throat) 
 Jets projected lineup 
 Kyle Connor -- Mark Scheifele -- Gabriel Vilardi
 Cole Perfetti -- Brayden Yager -- Dawson Mercer
 Alex Iafallo -- Adam Lowry -- Viggo Bjorck
 Cole Koepke -- Morgan Barron -- Isak Rosen
 Dylan Samberg -- Neal Pionk
 Josh Morrissey -- Dylan DeMelo
 Mario Ferraro -- Tyrel Bauer
 Nico Daws
 Stuart Skinner
 Scratched: Clay Stevenson, Nino Niederreiter, Haydn Fleury 
 Injured: Nick Bjugstad (undisclosed) 
 Status report 
 New Jersey recalled Tufte, a forward, from Utica of the American Hockey League on Monday. … The Devils will use the same lineup of 11 forwards and seven defensemen from a 4-0 win at the Toronto Maple Leafs on Sunday. … The Jets held an optional skate. … Morrissey returns after missing 13 games with an upper-body injury. He replaces Fleury.
